description: This file defines the Duplicates class which provides functionality for creating and manipulating conditional formatting rules related to detecting duplicate or unique values in a spreadsheet cell range within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: Duplicates
classes.description: Provides a wizard for creating conditional formatting rules that identify either duplicate or unique values within a specified cell range.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the Duplicates class for a specific cell range, with an option to invert the condition for unique values.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Sets whether the conditional formatting rule should be inverted.

methods.name: getConditional
methods.description: Generates and returns a Conditional object representing the current duplicate/unique rule.

methods.name: fromConditional
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Duplicates wizard from an existing Conditional object, verifying that it is a duplicate or unique rule.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Dynamically handles method calls to set the rule type to duplicates or unique based on method name.
